verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
verses.pt: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Timóteo,
verses.en_web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.en_bbe: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the purpose of God, and Timothy our brother,

verses.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: aos santos e fiéis irmãos em Cristo que estão em Colossos: Graças a vós, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai.
verses.en_web: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: To the saints and true brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.

verses.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.pt: Graças damos a Deus, Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, orando sempre por vós,
verses.en_web: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.en_bbe: We give praise to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, making prayer for you at all times,

verses.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
verses.pt: desde que ouvimos falar da vossa fé em Cristo Jesus, e do amor que tendes a todos os santos,
verses.en_web: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
verses.en_bbe: After hearing of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have for all the saints,

verses.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.pt: por causa da esperança que vos está reservada nos céus, da qual antes ouvistes pela palavra da verdade do evangelho,
verses.en_web: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,
verses.en_bbe: Through the hope which is in store for you in heaven; knowledge of which was given to you before in the true word of the good news,

verses.en: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
verses.pt: que já chegou a vós, como também está em todo o mundo, frutificando e crescendo, assim como entre vós desde o dia em que ouvistes e conhecestes a graça de Deus em verdade,
verses.en_web: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;
verses.en_bbe: Which has come to you; and which in all the world is giving fruit and increase, as it has done in you from the day when it came to your ears and you had true knowledge of the grace of God;

verses.en: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
verses.pt: segundo aprendestes de Epafras, nosso amado conservo, que por nós é fiel ministro de Cristo.
verses.en_web: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,
verses.en_bbe: As it was given to you by Epaphras, our well-loved helper, who is a true servant of Christ for us,

verses.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.pt: O qual também nos declarou o vosso amor no Espírito.
verses.en_web: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: And who, himself, made clear to us your love in the Spirit.

verses.en: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.pt: Por esta razão, nós também, desde o dia em que ouvimos, não cessamos de orar por vós, e de pedir que sejais cheios do pleno conhecimento da sua vontade, em toda a sabedoria e entendimento espiritual;
verses.en_web: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, we, from the day when we had word of it, keep on in prayer for you, that you may be full of the knowledge of his purpose, with all wisdom and experience of the Spirit,

verses.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.pt: para que possais andar de maneira digna do Senhor, agradando-lhe em tudo, frutificando em toda boa obra, e crescendo no conhecimento de Deus,
verses.en_web: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.en_bbe: Living uprightly in the approval of the Lord, giving fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

verses.en: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.pt: corroborados com toda a fortaleza, segundo o poder da sua glória, para toda a perseverança e longanimidade com gozo;
verses.en_web: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;
verses.en_bbe: Full of strength in the measure of the great power of his glory, so that you may undergo all troubles with joy;

verses.en: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
verses.pt: dando graças ao Pai que vos fez idôneos para participar da herança dos santos na luz,
verses.en_web: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;
verses.en_bbe: Giving praise to the Father who has given us a part in the heritage of the saints in light;

verses.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
verses.pt: e que nos tirou do poder das trevas, e nos transportou para o reino do seu Filho amado;
verses.en_web: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;
verses.en_bbe: Who has made us free from the power of evil and given us a place in the kingdom of the Son of his love;

verses.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
verses.pt: em quem temos a redenção, a saber, a remissão dos pecados;
verses.en_web: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins;
verses.en_bbe: In whom we have our salvation, the forgiveness of sins:

verses.en: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
verses.pt: o qual é imagem do Deus invisível, o primogênito de toda a criação;
verses.en_web: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
verses.en_bbe: Who is the image of the unseen God coming into existence before all living things;

verses.en: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.pt: porque nele foram criadas todas as coisas nos céus e na terra, as visíveis e as invisíveis, sejam tronos, sejam dominações, sejam principados, sejam potestades; tudo foi criado por ele e para ele.
verses.en_web: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.
verses.en_bbe: For by him all things were made, in heaven and on earth, things seen and things unseen, authorities, lords, rulers, and powers; all things were made by him and for him;

verses.en: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.pt: Ele é antes de todas as coisas, e nele subsistem todas as coisas;
verses.en_web: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
verses.en_bbe: He is before all things, and in him all things have being.

verses.en: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.pt: também ele é a cabeça do corpo, da igreja; é o princípio, o primogênito dentre os mortos, para que em tudo tenha a preeminência,
verses.en_web: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.en_bbe: And he is the head of the body, the church: the starting point of all things, the first to come again from the dead; so that in all things he might have the chief place.

verses.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.pt: porque aprouve a Deus que nele habitasse toda a plenitude,
verses.en_web: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;
verses.en_bbe: For God in full measure was pleased to be in him;

verses.en: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
verses.pt: e que, havendo por ele feito a paz pelo sangue da sua cruz, por meio dele reconciliasse consigo mesmo todas as coisas, tanto as que estão na terra como as que estão nos céus.
verses.en_web: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
verses.en_bbe: Through him uniting all things with himself, having made peace through the blood of his cross; through him, I say, uniting all things which are on earth or in heaven.

verses.en: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
verses.pt: A vós também, que outrora éreis estranhos, e inimigos no entendimento pelas vossas obras más,
verses.en_web: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
verses.en_bbe: And you, who in the past were cut off and at war with God in your minds through evil works, he has now made one

verses.en: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.pt: agora contudo vos reconciliou no corpo da sua carne, pela morte, a fim de perante ele vos apresentar santos, sem defeito e irrepreensíveis,
verses.en_web: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
verses.en_bbe: In the body of his flesh through death, so that you might be holy and without sin and free from all evil before him:

verses.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.pt: se é que permaneceis na fé, fundados e firmes, não vos deixando apartar da esperança do evangelho que ouvistes, e que foi pregado a toda criatura que há debaixo do céu, e do qual eu, Paulo, fui constituído ministro.
verses.en_web: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
verses.en_bbe: If you keep yourselves safely based in the faith, not moved from the hope of the good news which came to you, and which was given to every living being under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

verses.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
verses.pt: Agora me regozijo no meio dos meus sofrimentos por vós, e cumpro na minha carne o que resta das aflições de Cristo, por amor do seu corpo, que é a igreja;
verses.en_web: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly;
verses.en_bbe: Now I have joy in my pain because of you, and in my flesh I undergo whatever is still needed to make the sorrows of Christ complete, for the salvation of his body, the church;

verses.en: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
verses.pt: da qual eu fui constituído ministro segundo a dispensação de Deus, que me foi concedida para convosco, a fim de cumprir a palavra de Deus,
verses.en_web: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,
verses.en_bbe: Of which I became a servant by the purpose of God which was given to me for you, to give effect to the word of God,

verses.en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
verses.pt: o mistério que esteve oculto dos séculos, e das gerações; mas agora foi manifesto aos seus santos,
verses.en_web: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
verses.en_bbe: The secret which has been kept from all times and generations, but has now been made clear to his saints,

verses.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verses.pt: a quem Deus quis fazer conhecer quais são as riquezas da glória deste mistério entre os gentios, que é Cristo em vós, a esperança da glória;
verses.en_web: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;
verses.en_bbe: To whom God was pleased to give knowledge of the wealth of the glory of this secret among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

verses.en: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
verses.pt: o qual nós anunciamos, admoestando a todo homem, e ensinando a todo homem em toda a sabedoria, para que apresentemos todo homem perfeito em Cristo;
verses.en_web: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
verses.en_bbe: Whom we are preaching; guiding and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that every man may be complete in Christ;

verses.en: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
verses.pt: para isso também trabalho, lutando segundo a sua eficácia, que opera em mim poderosamente.
verses.en_web: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
verses.en_bbe: And for this purpose I am working, using all my strength by the help of his power which is working in me strongly.
